decisions.summary: The explicit site-wide design brief supersedes the earlier editorial palette. Echo Chamber, Mettle, and Memora form the featured trilogy; the other seven product routes remain available. Memora retains its documented flashcard and spaced-repetition function with an archival visual treatment.
Replaced by the user-supplied reference direction. Study source is archived and excluded from production build entries.

User supplied Raycast, Family, Chronicle, Linear, and Nothing. Real app screenshots, glass surfaces, Signal Green, violet light, measured type, spatial product motion, and an interactive local hardware illustration now lead the site.

Founder approved the research proposal. Update Brand Doctrine first; replace repeated manifesto with distinct product workflows, direct released-app CTA, concise accurate boundaries, real screen previews and equally finished artwork. Preserve Philosophy opening. No public deployment or new tracking.

Full collection visibility and release-aware navigation; task-led copy across ten apps and22 journal entries; wider normal-flow headings; matched benefit anatomy; initial route CSS and rendered schema-content validation.

Memora is released alongside Echo Chamber. Real Mac and iPhone captures appear together only in the Echo Chamber app-page hero; the homepage hero retains three mobile apps. Mobile uses native scrolling and an edge-to-edge feathered header that hides on downward scroll and returns on upward scroll. The wordmark places the slash between Obsidian and Ridge, and the footer baseline stays on one line.
